voxel_statistics: sum_xyz, sum_rgb_u8, point_count; representative is per-voxel arithmetic mean
admission: assigned non-alias observations only; deferred observations excluded; raw evidence remains append-only
same_observation_idempotency: same ID and same payload hash is a no-op; same ID with a different payload hash is an error
independent_view_rule: unique sensor pose fingerprint after rounding the full T_W_Copt matrix to 6 decimal places; exact pose repeats do not add independent-view support
geometry_repeat_policy: each distinct assigned observation contributes its selected points once, even when pose repeats; repeat observations do not increase independent-view count

resource_policy.overflow: fail the run before silently dropping evidence
